changes: original_meaning 纠正词义先后：拉丁语 palma 的首义是『手掌』，『棕榈树』是因叶形似手指得名的后起义（Etymonline 明言 the tree so called from the shape of its leaves, like fingers of a hand；牛津同）。现行字段树义在前、手义在后，顺序反了。
semantic_path 按三站重建（手掌 → 棕榈树 → 14 世纪末胜利象征）。
evidence: Etymonline: "from Latin palma \"palm of the hand,\" also \"flat end of an oar; palm tree,\""
Etymonline: "palm (n.2)... from Latin palma \"palm tree,\" originally \"palm of the hand;\" the tree so called from the shape of its leaves, like fingers of a hand"
Etymonline: "In ancient times, a leaf or frond of the palm was carried or worn as a symbol of victory or triumph... hence figurative use of palm for \"victory, triumph\" (late 14c.)."
Oxford: "from Latin palma 'palm (of a hand)', its leaf being likened to a spread hand."
palm.mechanism_sentence: palma 本是「张开的手掌」：棕榈叶摊开像五根手指，树就借了手的名字——手掌和棕榈树，一个词，两种「张开」。

semantic_path.how: 树是拿手命名的：棕榈叶张开的形状像摊开的五指（Etymonline 与牛津一致的说法），palma 便添了『棕榈树』义，随基督教北传进古英语（棕枝主日的棕榈枝即此）。
古人庆贺胜利时手持棕榈枝：14 世纪末起 palm 本身直接指『胜利、优胜』（the palm）——从树枝转到它所象征的荣誉（借代）。

changes: original_meaning 按拉丁语 pannus 的 gloss 收为「一块布」。
semantic_path 按 Etymonline 编年重建三站（布 → 14 世纪末陪审团名单/陪审团、1570 年代评议组 → 约 1600 年镶板），现行第二站把数百年的分义揉作一团，已拆开。
evidence: Etymonline: "panel (n.) early 14c., \"a piece of cloth,\" especially a rectangular piece, from Old French panel \"piece of cloth, piece, saddle cushion\"... from Vulgar Latin *pannellus, diminutive of Latin pannus \"piece of cloth\""

Etymonline: "Anglo-French legalese sense of \"piece of parchment (cloth) listing the names of those summoned to serve upon a jury\" led by late 14c. to the meaning \"a jury selected for a trial.\" General sense of \"persons called on to advise, judge, discuss,\" etc. is from 1570s. Sense of \"more or less distinct part of the surface of a wall, door, etc.\" is recorded from c. 1600."
panel.mechanism_sentence: panel 是拉丁语 pannus「一块布」的缩小版：写陪审员名单的那张『布』，变成了名单上的一组人（陪审团、专家组）；平平整整的『一块』，又成了墙上的镶板和机器的面板。

semantic_path.how: 载体变成了内容（转喻）：盎格鲁-法语法律行话里 panel 指写着候选陪审员名单的羊皮纸，14 世纪末名单本身转指名单上的人——『陪审团』；1570 年代泛化为受邀评议、讨论的一组人，词库『专门小组』即此支。
semantic_path.meaning: （陪审员）名单；陪审团，专门小组

semantic_path.how: 另一支靠形状走：『平整的一块』约 1600 年起指墙面、门面上划分出的独立平面（镶板）——今天的控制面板、仪表盘也是这个『一块平面』的后代。

changes: original_meaning 与希腊语 panikos 的 gloss 对齐为「潘神的（引起的）」。
semantic_path 重建三站（潘神的 → 约 1600 年形容词/1708 年名词恐慌 → 1757 年金融恐慌），how 写明神话来源与传染性语义核，替换套话。
evidence: Etymonline: "panic (n.1) \"sudden mass terror\"... 1708, from an earlier adjective (c. 1600, modifying fear, terror, etc.), from French panique (15c.), from Greek panikon, literally \"pertaining to Pan,\" the god of woods and fields, who was the source of mysterious sounds that caused contagious, groundless fear in herds and crowds... short for panikon deima \"panic fright\""
Etymonline: "The meaning \"widespread apprehension in a trading community about financial matters\" is recorded by 1757."
Oxford: "from Greek panikos, from the name of the god Pan in Greek mythology, noted for causing terror"
panic.mechanism_sentence: panic 是希腊语「潘神的」：荒野里没来由的声响和惊惧，古人记在这位林野之神头上——panikon deima「潘神式惊惧」一路传下来，就成了「恐慌」。

semantic_path.how: 潘神（Pan）是林野之神，希腊人把原野上无缘无故、互相传染的惊惧归到他名下（panikon deima『潘神式惊惧』）：经法语 panique，英语约 1600 年先用作形容词（panic fear），1708 年名词义定型为『突发的群体恐慌』（Etymonline 编年）。
恐慌蔓延到了市场：1757 年 panic 添金融义，指交易圈里对财务的集体惊慌（挤兑、抛售那类）——靠的还是老核：恐惧会传染（Etymonline 编年）。

changes: original_meaning 与希腊语 paragraphos 的 gloss 对齐为「行边标示分段的短划」，并写明构词（para- 在旁边 + graphein 写）。
semantic_path 第二站 how 依 Etymonline 明文（The sense shifted from the mark to the thing itself）说明标记→段落的转喻，替换套话。
evidence: Etymonline: "from Greek paragraphos \"short stroke below the beginning of a line marking a break in sense,\" also \"a passage so marked,\" literally \"anything written beside,\" from paragraphein \"write by the side,\" from para- \"beside\" + graphein \"to write\""

Etymonline: "paragraph (n.) c. 1500, paragraf, \"a distinct part of writing or discourse relating to a particular point,\" also \"paragraph mark, the symbol used to mark commencement of a new section of writing\" (¶), from Old French paragrafe (13c.), from Medieval Latin paragraphus \"sign indicating the start of a new section of a discourse\"... The sense shifted from the mark to the thing itself."
paragraph.mechanism_sentence: paragraph 是希腊语「写在旁边的东西」（para- 旁边 + graphein 写）：原是抄写人在行边划的一道分段小记号；后来记号退场（改用换行缩进），名字被它标出的那段文字领走了。
paragraph.original_meaning: 行边标示分段的短划（段落符号）

semantic_path.meaning: 行边标示分段的短划（段落符号）

semantic_path.how: 词义从符号滑到了符号标出的东西本身（转喻，Etymonline 明言）：英语约 1500 年的 paragraph 既指 ¶ 号、也指被它断开的那段文字；如今 ¶ 只在校对场合露面，段落靠换行缩进表示，词就专管那段文字——词库今义即此。
